claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is launching no earlier than April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
Artemis II sends four astronauts on a ~10-day journey around the Moon and back.
Artemis II tests the SLS rocket.
Artemis II tests the Orion capsule.
The crew of Artemis II consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
An objective of Artemis II is to test life-support systems.
An objective of Artemis II is to verify deep-space navigation.
An objective of Artemis II is to perform lunar observations.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II aims to travel farther than any human before.
The launch site for Artemis II is Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The Artemis III landing mission is scheduled for 2028
